sreperf.help: Diagnostics: /sreperf start [seconds 10–180] [sampling interval 10–100 ms]; stop; status; mark <label>; last frame report. memory: local snapshot; memory histogram: class sizes (may pause); memory allocation [10–180 seconds]: allocation samples. Server: /sreperfserver memory (permission 2).
sreperf.started: Capture queued for %s seconds, sampling every %s ms. Close chat and keep the game focused in the slow scene. A local report will be exported automatically.
sreperf.busy: A capture or export is already running. Please wait.
sreperf.stopping: Capture will stop and export at the end of the current frame.
sreperf.exporting: Generating the performance report in the background…
sreperf.mark_failed: Cannot mark: no capture is active or the limit of 64 markers was reached.
sreperf.no_report: No report has been generated in this game session.
sreperf.failed: Diagnostics failed: %s. Check the log, disk space, and permissions.
sreperf.cancelled: Capture was cancelled before it started.
sreperf.memory.server_help: Server memory diagnostics (permission 2): /sreperfserver memory [histogram | allocation [seconds 10–180]]. Reports stay on the server. /sreperf memory is LOCAL on clients with this mod.
sreperf.memory.started: Local JVM memory snapshot queued; loaded-world counts collected without loading chunks.
sreperf.memory.busy: A memory diagnostic is already running in this JVM. Please wait.
sreperf.memory.histogram_warning: Explicit histogram requested: a safepoint heap scan may briefly PAUSE the game/server. Using gcClassHistogram -all without requesting GC; shallow bytes are NOT mod retained heap.
sreperf.memory.allocation_started: JFR allocation sampling queued for %s seconds (32 MiB rolling cap). Allocations are NOT retained memory. Unsupported runtimes will report a reason.
sreperf.memory.saved: Memory report saved locally: %s (report.txt / report.json; not a frame-report ZIP).
sreperf.memory.unsupported: Requested diagnostic is unavailable or failed; reason is included in the report: %s
sreperf.memory.failed: Memory diagnostics failed: %s. Check logs, disk space and permissions; partial files may remain.
sreperf.memory.cancelled: Memory diagnostic cancelled during shutdown; an incomplete report directory may remain.
